detail: Resolution is creation plus 15-45 whole minutes, carrying the identical millisecond. Breaks every measure of speed. Fixing it also makes issue 2 testable.

Every row carries a resolution and every row is processing_type = Manual, so automated or still-open tickets may never have reached the extract. Nothing bounds how many, because the timestamps that would are the generated ones. Every count is a floor, not a total.
13 days, 26 Jun to 8 Jul 2022. No seasonality, one like-for-like week-over-week comparison, and four-year-old data is not operational.

issue: Two conflicting fields describe the language
detail: language_dwid disagrees with the queue on 3,239 tickets, always toward English, and steps on 4 July. Mitigated by using the queue, at the cost of per-language detail.

issue: We cannot tell whether the demand decline is real
detail: Intake falls from about 2,100 a day to about 1,050. Not a calendar effect, but a genuine decline and an extraction artefact look identical given issue 2.

issue: The resolved series is cut off at the end of the window
detail: 10 tickets resolve after the last creation day. Daily counts are not truncated; the effect is confined to the first day of a filtered range.

issue: 18 'Helpdesk communication' tickets are a group of their own
detail: Unknown language, null refund flags, no queue or request type. Labelled Unclassified so they stay visible. 0.09% of rows.

issue: Refund flags are set on some non-refund tickets
detail: 25 and 26 tickets respectively. They look booking-level, but every positive flag sits on a single-ticket booking, so that cannot be tested. Refund volume is unaffected.

issue: Japanese and Korean queues are not split by refund
detail: A refund breakdown is not comparable across every queue.
Every daily figure is a UTC day - nine hours out of step with the local working day for the Japanese queue.

issue: Dates in the language table are stored inconsistently
detail: date_valid_from is text, date_valid_to is a date, both with 1899/2999 placeholders. The table is not used beyond name lookup.

issue: Two columns in the language table carry nothing
detail: is_valid is always true, and name and description are identical in all 185 rows.

issue: Most of the language table is unused
detail: 185 rows, 40 referenced, 16 of those with fewer than 5 tickets.

issue: Timestamps are precise to the millisecond
detail: Spreadsheets display them truncated to the minute. Finer than the documentation claims.

issue: About 9% of bookings generate more than one ticket
detail: Not a defect - an insight. Repeat contact hints at tickets not being resolved first time.
